direction.situation: On a rainy Colombo roadside, Anudi checks her phone after it interrupts her conversation with Kasun. The incoming call draws her attention away from their warm exchange.
direction.people: Only Anudi's right hand and the edge of her cream sleeve are in frame. She holds the phone below her face, her attention caught by the call.

flow.text: Anudi's right fingers support the phone without touching the screen. Her hand settles from a slight tremor into a steady hold.
The incoming-call display remains lit and readable. Her thumb rests along the side without answering.

direction.camera: Locked-off extreme close-up from a roadside high oblique angle, with the display filling most of the steady tripod frame.
direction.sound: Continuous light rain, soft road wash and the incoming phone ring; no music.
